galaxy_spectroscopic_redshift.instruction: Estimate the spectroscopic redshift of an SDSS galaxy from its broadband photometry.
galaxy_spectroscopic_redshift.field_description: dereddened_model_magnitude gives extinction-corrected SDSS model magnitudes in the u, g, r, i, and z imaging filters. model_magnitude_error gives the reported model photometry error per filter, in magnitudes. The z filter is a photometric band.
